title: My Sister-In-Law Forged My Signature, Sold My 45% For $680K, Left Me $3,800. So I Voided It
description: My sister-in-law forged my signature, sold my 45% of the heritage cider orchard for $680,000, and handed me a $3,800 pomace check. I found the original partnership contract inside a hollow oak barrel bung, voided the sale, and kept the cidery. Now she scrubs the press hopper in a smock that says Pressed Out Trust while every bottle label prints her fraud docket number. #FamilyBetrayal #CiderRevenge #JusticeServed
thumb_text: I VOIDED HER SALE WITH AN OAK BARREL BUNG
pinned_comment: I know exactly what I did when my sister-in-law forged my signature, sold my 45% for $680,000, and handed me that $3,800 pomace check, but what would you have done the moment you found the contract inside the oak barrel bung? Tell me your story in the comments.
